registration.coordinateSystem: Native target crop pixels; top-left origin; half-open bounds
registration.method: Uniformly match the measured full ink height, then align ink bounding-box centres. No rotation, anisotropic scaling, warping, separate part fitting, or automatic feature optimisation.
registration.limitation: This is a common visual scale, not identical physical printed size. Full-width difference includes the source's projecting scroll tails. Fine line and pixel-overlap scores would be misleading for different engravings at this resolution.

overlay.sourceTone: Per-pixel alpha = clip((245 - grayscale) / 160, 0, 1). Analytical tint only; original crop is also shown unchanged.
overlay.purpose: Show broad geometry mismatches; not an artwork source or similarity score

structuralStudy.method: Manually constructed Bezier curves and line segments in native-crop coordinates, grouped by visible crown envelope, shield sides and motto-scroll structure. No automatic tracing and no reused generated-master anatomy.
